words: intelligent

present

dictionary

phrases: Full of mistakes
表示充满错误，常用于评价工作质量
This letter's full of mistakes.
这封信满是错误。
Your homework is full of mistakes.
你的作业满是错误。
Come at once
命令或要求某人立即前来
Tell her to come at once.
让她立刻来。
The manager wants you to come at once.
经理要你立刻来。
How do you spell...?
用于询问单词的拼写方式
How do you spell 'intelligent'?
'intelligent'怎么拼写？
How do you spell your name?
你的名字怎么拼写？
I want you to...
表达希望某人做某事
I want you to type it again.
我想让你再打一遍。
I want you to come to my office.
我想让你来我的办公室。
Here's a little present for you
送礼物时的常用表达
And here's a little present for you.
这是给你的一点小礼物。
Here's a little present for your birthday.
这是给你的生日小礼物。
I hope it'll help you
送礼物时表达良好祝愿
I hope it'll help you.
我希望它能帮助你。
I hope it'll help you with your studies.
我希望它能帮助你学习。
I'm sorry about that
为错误或疏忽道歉
I'm sorry about that.
关于那件事我很抱歉。
I'm sorry about the mistake.
对于这个错误我很抱歉。
Can you tell me?
礼貌地请求信息
Can you tell me?
你能告诉我吗？
Can you tell me how to get to the station?
你能告诉我怎么去车站吗？
Did you want to see me?
确认某人是否要找自己
Did you want to see me?
你想见我吗？
The boss is here. Did you want to see him?
老板在这儿，你想见他吗？
I want her to come to my office
表示希望第三人去某地
I want her to come to my office.
我想让她来我的办公室。
I want him to finish the work today.
我想让他今天完成这项工作。

grammar.k: Want + 宾语 + to + 动词原形
grammar.f: 主语 + want + 宾语 + to + 动词原形
grammar.d: 表示说话者希望或要求另一个人做某事 用于表达想让某人做某事的意愿，want后面需要跟宾语（人），再加to引导的不定式短语
ex: I want her to come to my office.
我想让她来我的办公室。
I want you to type it again.
Do you want her to come at once?

grammar.k: Tell + 宾语 + to + 动词原形
grammar.f: 主语 + tell + 宾语 + to + 动词原形
grammar.d: 表示命令或指示某人做某事 用于传达命令或指示，要求宾语（通常是人）执行某个动作
ex: Tell her to come at once.

grammar.k: Have/Has + 过去分词（现在完成时）
grammar.f: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.d: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果 常与just连用，表示刚刚完成的动作。在本课中用于指出对方的错误
ex: You've typed it with only one 'L'.

patterns.p: I want + 宾语 + to + 动词原形
o: I want her to come to my office.
我想让她来我的办公室。
im: I want him to type this letter.
I want them to come at once.

patterns.p: Tell + 宾语 + to + 动词原形
o: Tell her to come at once.
im: Tell them to finish the work.

patterns.p: How do you spell + 单词?
im: How do you spell your name?

patterns.p: I hope + 主语 + 动词...
im: I hope it'll help you with your English.
我希望它能帮助你学英语。
I hope she'll like this present.
我希望她会喜欢这份礼物。
